meta.name: talking-head-recut
meta.description: Package an existing talking-head / interview / podcast video with timed, designed GRAPHIC OVERLAY cards — kinetic titles, lower-thirds, data callouts, quotes, side panels, picture-in-picture — synced to the transcript, on a 16:9 / 9:16 / 4:5 canvas of your choice; the clip plays untouched underneath. Trigger on "graphic overlays", "on-screen graphics", "package / dress up my video". Not plain subtitles (/embedded-captions). Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 给视频添加动态图文叠加层，同步字幕与画面
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要为访谈或播客视频添加专业图文卡片
copy.tagline_en: Add timed graphic overlays to videos, synced with transcript
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to add professional graphic cards to interview or podcast videos

howto.what: 给已有的讲话/采访/播客视频叠加与转录同步的设计图形卡片(动态标题、lower-thirds、数据标注、引语、侧栏、画中画),视频原样播放,最终渲染成 MP4。它会先提取音频做本地转录,再按内容设计卡片并生成 HTML。
howto.when: 当用户提到“图形覆盖”“屏幕图形”“包装/装饰我的视频”等关键词,或要求给讲话/采访/播客视频加设计图形而不是纯字幕时触发。不明确时交给 /hyperframes 判断。

say.text: 给这段采访加上和语音同步的图形卡片
say.note: Claude 会转录视频并设计卡片。

say.text: 把我这个播客视频包装成竖版 9:16 带数据标注
say.note: 输出带侧栏数据的 MP4。

say.text: 为视频生成 lower-thirds 和引语卡片
say.note: 按转录内容自动布局卡片。

howto.what_en: Adds transcript-synced graphic cards (titles, lower-thirds, data callouts, quotes, side panels, PiP) over an existing video; the clip plays untouched. It transcribes audio locally, designs cards from the transcript, writes HTML, and renders MP4.
howto.when_en: Triggered by 'graphic overlays', 'on-screen graphics', or 'package/dress up my video', or any request for designed graphics on a talking video (not plain subtitles). Unclear cases defer to /hyperframes.

say_en.text: Add transcript-synced graphic cards to this interview.
Dress up my podcast video as 9:16 with data callouts.
Add lower-thirds and quote cards for this video.
say_en.note: Cards are placed according to the transcript.
